content.comment_body: I only get this issue with Google Chrome, both on my desktop and laptop. When I use MS Edge, I get the expected result. Interestingly, this problem doesn't happen on my smartphone or my inexpensive tablet (Android Kitkat 4.4), both also using Chrome. Accessing [product_name] occurs via LAN. Does anyone have suggestions about what might be wrong or where to investigate?
Hello, try starting Chrome and, if you see the error, press CTRL & F5. I've been using Chrome for years without any problems together with [product_name].
Hello, perhaps this thread will be useful: [url]
Thanks for your help, but I've already described my problem in that topic. That's why I opened this new discussion.

Not meant negatively, but the situation remains unchanged. The error persists. As mentioned before, there’s no problem with my smartphone or the basic tablet. Given this, I’ll continue using MS Edge to connect to [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a '404: The target is not found' error when trying to reach [product_name] via Google Chrome from Windows PCs, but not on Chrome on Android devices. Microsoft Edge works correctly. The issue seems to be specific to Chrome on Windows platforms, affecting the reliability and consistency of web access to the [product_name] device.
